name: aion-presence
description: A visual embodiment layer for Codex. Codex does the reasoning and the work; Aion gives it a quiet particle body that listens, reflects real activity, answers with it and turns information into visual forms. No API key, no second model.

interface.longDescription: Aion is the embodied presence of the Codex agent you are already using. Codex remains the intelligence; Aion is its body: a particle sphere or figure that listens (locally), reflects meaningful work (thinking, reading, editing, testing, building), answers with Codex, and turns information into visual forms: portraits, real terrain, constellations, Tao symbols, clocks, results and images. Aion makes no model API calls and needs no API key.
